_comment: WAF rules to apply via the Vercel Firewall API or dashboard. Hobby plan limits: 5 custom rules + 1 rate-limit rule total. Apply each `rules.insert` action with: curl -X PATCH 'https://api.vercel.com/v1/security/firewall/config?projectId=PRJ&teamId=TEAM' -H "Authorization: Bearer $VERCEL_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '<one action object>'  — or just paste each `value` into Project > Firewall > Custom Rules in the dashboard.

value.name: Waitlist signup rate limit
value.description: Cap waitlist signups at 3 per minute per IP.
